parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the SMB user. The password cannot be empty. The password can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: !, @, #, $, %, ^, &, and \*.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username of the SMB user. The username must be 1 to 32 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).
